items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Like I told Miss Plenty, I said Miss Plenty... I'd be glad to work with Octavia... She's helped, man, and she keep that job.

ctx.x: No. And see the union, you can't force you to go there. That woman wake you too hard. Man, you know she pick up on all them old town numbers like old, what you call it? High-side, high-side, high-side, sweet Georgia Brown. And all them old red book numbers. Like Coca-Cola Hagen and all that. And all that's hard on your lip. That'd be different than they had another trumpet player there. That's right. That's what they really need in that place, two trumpets. That's what they need in that place, two trumpets. Well…
